paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: The line plot, titled “ReDial,” illustrates how two performance metrics—Recall@50 and NDCG@50—change as a function of search depth, ranging from 1 to 5 on the x-axis. The left y-axis, labeled “Recall@50,” spans from 0.30 to 0.60 with major tick marks at intervals of 0.05, while the right y-axis, labeled “NDCG@50,” ranges from 0.15 to 0.22 with tick marks every 0.01. Four lines are plotted: “Recall@50 (Ours)” (solid green line with circular markers) starts at approximately 0.35 at depth 1 and rises steadily to 0.49 at depth 5; “Recall@50 (ReFICR)” (dotted green line) remains nearly constant at 0.48 across all depths; “NDCG@50 (Ours)” (solid blue line with square markers) begins at 0.16 at depth 1 and increases to 0.185 at depth 5; and “NDCG@50 (ReFICR)” (dotted blue line) stays flat at 0.15 throughout. All lines show either steady growth or stability, with the “Ours” methods improving with search depth while the ReFICR baselines remain unchanged.
